text: Reset your account password If you cannot sign in because you forgot your password, open the sign-in page and choose Forgot password. Enter the email address registered to your account. Follow the password reset link sent to that mailbox and choose a new password. The link expires after thirty minutes. If you cannot access the registered mailbox or your two-factor authentication device, contact the workspace administrator. Never share passwords or verification codes in a support message. These are fictional instructions for the cookbook's sample team.

Billing and refunds The sample team's subscription renews on the first day of each month. Download invoices and payment receipts from the Billing section. An administrator can update the billing address, tax number or payment card before the next renewal. For a duplicate payment or an unused subscription refund, send the invoice number to the finance team. A refund review normally takes five business days. Cancelling a subscription stops the following renewal and leaves access active until the paid period ends. These are fictional sample policies.

Office hours and building access The sample office is open Monday through Friday from nine in the morning until six in the evening. Use your assigned badge at the entrance. Visitors should register with reception and stay with their host while inside the building. Reserve meeting rooms in the shared calendar. Cancel a reservation if plans change so another team can use the room. Contact reception for a replacement badge or help with building access. These locations and policies are fictional examples.

Remote work and collaboration The sample team supports remote work when your manager has approved the arrangement. Keep your working hours current in the team calendar and tell colleagues when you will be away. Store work documents in the shared project space rather than a personal account. Use the approved company device and secure network connection for work. Schedule discussions during overlapping hours and summarize decisions for teammates in other timezones. This is a fictional team policy used to demonstrate document embeddings.

Reporting a technical problem If an application feature fails, collect the error message, approximate time and a short set of steps that reproduce the issue. Include the affected application version and whether the problem also occurs in another browser. Do not include passwords, access tokens or private customer data in a screenshot. For an urgent outage, contact the sample on-call support channel. Routine bugs can be filed in the issue tracker. Describe the expected result and the result you observed. These instructions are fictional sample content.

Travel expenses and reimbursement For approved business travel, keep itemized receipts for trains, flights, hotels and meals. Submit the receipts with the trip purpose and project code in the expense portal. The sample policy asks travelers to submit within fourteen days of returning. Ask your manager to approve the report before finance reimburses it. Personal purchases and missing receipts need a separate explanation. Check the travel budget before booking a non-refundable ticket. This fictional policy exists only as a document search example.
